Here’s a **notable Sherlock Holmes movies list** — not every obscure short/TV film, but the main ones people usually look for. There are many Sherlock adaptations, including a famous **14-film Basil Rathbone/Nigel Bruce series** and later Robert Downey Jr., Enola Holmes, and other spin-offs. ([editorial.rottentomatoes.com](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/guide/sherlock-holmes-movies-series-best-worst/?utm_source=openai))

7. **The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes** — 1935  
8. **Silver Blaze** / **Murder at the Baskervilles** — 1937

14. **Dressed to Kill** — 1946  

## Later notable Sherlock Holmes films

3. **The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes** — 1970  
4. **The Seven-Per-Cent Solution** — 1976
